Question: What coverage ratio does the Levi Strauss 2006 indenture require for incurring debt?

Answer: The Levi Strauss 2006 indenture requires that the coverage ratio, defined as a ratio of the Company's consolidated EBITDA to fixed charges, including interest, for the trailing four quarter period on a pro forma basis, be at least 2.0 to 1.0 for the incurrence of additional indebtedness [boyd10k; Item 7; p. 39; c0453], [boyd10q; Section I.2; c0426], [boyd10k; Item 8; p. 78; c0861].
